author: Edith Wharton
title: Ethan Frome
edition: Wikisource transcription (Index: Ethan Frome (Scribners 1911).djvu) of New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1911 (copyright 1911; published October 1911). Every selected word was collated against OCR of a dated 1911 Scribner scan (Internet Archive ethanfrome00wharrich) with Project Gutenberg #4517 as a second witness; two Wikisource misreadings ('Bale's', 'fry') were corrected to the page images ('Hale's', 'try'), and other variants were confirmed visually. In Chapter IX and the Epilogue the 1911 first printing has blanks where type failed to print, reproduced by Wikisource. Four letters are supplied from the later Scribner Modern Student’s Library printing (copyright 1911, 1922; Internet Archive ethanfrome0000edit), which prints them: Chapter IX ‘s’ in “so yourself” and ‘e’ in “under his palm”; Epilogue ‘r’ in “for her” and ‘s’ in “considering”. Each night’s context repeats its supplied letters. One Wikisource misplacement of a closing quotation mark is corrected to the 1911 print. A row of points closing Chapter IX and a section ornament in the Epilogue are omitted. HTML presentation removed and whitespace normalized. The library holds the whole novel: the untitled opening frame (the Prologue), Chapters I–IX and the untitled closing frame (the Epilogue), under the book’s title. The collation and corrections above cover the passages used as nightly readings; elsewhere the Wikisource transcription is reproduced as transcribed.

rights.basis: Original English novel published in 1911 by Charles Scribner's Sons, before 1931; its US term has expired as of 2026. The dated scan is marked NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.

acquisition.method: MediaWiki parse API (action=parse, prop=text|revid) for the Wikisource subpages Prologue, Chapter 1–9 and Epilogue of Ethan_Frome_(Scribners_1911), fetched in the printed order of the main page Ethan_Frome_(Scribners_1911): Prologue (revision 7101402); Chapter 1 (revision 7101420); Chapter 2 (revision 7101421); Chapter 3 (revision 7102584); Chapter 4 (revision 7102859); Chapter 5 (revision 7104148); Chapter 6 (revision 7104212); Chapter 7 (revision 7104252); Chapter 8 (revision 7104253); Chapter 9 (revision 7104254); Epilogue (revision 7104256); downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the eleven JSON responses concatenated in that order. Removed the Wikisource header, page-number anchors, licence and other no-export elements, the row of points closing Chapter IX and the Epilogue’s section ornament; each HTML paragraph became a paragraph with whitespace (including no-break spaces) collapsed to single spaces and italics dropped to plain text; the centred gravestone inscription became a stanza; the book title became a level-1 heading and the chapter numerals level-2 headings. The ten word- and letter-level corrections the nightly selections carry from the edition’s declared collation (two misreadings, the four supplied letters, the misplaced closing quotation mark) were applied at the same places.
